summary: In the United States, Ospemifene carries the strongest FDA warning regarding endometrial cancer (cancer of the lining of the uterus) and cardiovascular disorders, which include harm to the heart and blood vessels, as well as nerve and brain harm [3][5]. Additional warnings for the drug list risks for blood clots, known or suspected breast cancer, and severe liver problems [5]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, rated the drug's potential liver risk at 56 and heart risk at 62, both in the medium range [M].
